text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Hrm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During lunch break, I was talking with 
Nishino Flower, but her mind seemed to be 
somewhere else.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah...! I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um... Actually, I wanted to thank Sky-san 
for the summer vegetable curry.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
And so, I was wondering if there was 
anything I could do to help, but—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: There, there~♪ Feels good, doesn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, leaving already? See ya later~!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(For now, it looks like she's just playing 
with the cat...)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: *Yaaawn*, no bites today, huh...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Ah...! Could it be they're in 
trouble...!?)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, kicking back and waiting like this 
is part of the fun too, though~...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
She kind of just goes with the flow, so to 
speak, and doesn't really seem troubled by 
anything...
choice_data_list:
If you don't have any problems, isn't that 
fine then?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: T-That's true, but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder if there's anything I can do 
to help.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look at the time. I need to get ready 
for training.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Here, it's lunch for you. I made 
Western-style side dishes today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The bento was neatly packed with 
hamburgers, croquettes, and other side 
dishes that would delight even adults.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I studied how to make delicious Salisbury 
steak sauce, and I really wanted you to 
try it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I take a bite of the hamburg steak. A 
rich, luxurious flavor spreads across my 
tongue, so delicious you'd think it was a 
restaurant's demi-glace sauce...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Fufu. I'm glad it suits your taste.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was so delicious that my reaction 
slipped right out of my mouth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not just this time, but Nishino Flower's 
bento always fills me with such happiness—
choice_data_list:
...That's right. You don't need to 
overthink it.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list: Why not just make them some normal food?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Still, if we do that... They'll just 
enjoy it like normal..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: You're right. I'll... give that a try!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Sky-saaan!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, Flower. What a coincidence~ What's up?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... I thought you might be getting 
hungry around now, so I brought a snack!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you read me like a book! I was just 
craving a little snack~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Still, for you to go out of your way to 
bring refreshments all the way here... did 
something happen?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, I wanted to thank you for helping me 
with the summer vegetable curry. Here, 
take this—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Salmon rice balls! Nice one~!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I figured something you could eat while 
fishing would be just the thing!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, nice! But since we're here, I really 
wanna savor it, so let's take a break from 
fishing.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Come on, Flower, let's eat together.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
They say food tastes better when you eat 
with someone else, right?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Then, don't mind if I do!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm. Rice balls really do taste best 
when eaten out in nature~♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: It has such a natural flavor!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Right~? Man, what a perfect day off. I 
couldn't ask for anything more.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The best, is it...? I'm glad. Hearing you 
say so means everything to me—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Gurgle gurgle gurgle)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whoa?! We got a bite!! This is... a big 
one! Flower, help me out!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Here we go, ready, set, go—!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Take this!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...I managed to catch it, but... What 
should I do with this fish—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Now this is a dilemma.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, leave it to me. I'll 
cook something that will make everyone 
happy!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...And with that, Trainer! Today's bento 
is packed with all kinds of fish. Please, 
dig in!"
